scope: Test a resolved native VARCHAR field for SQL NULL or presence. Compose as a SELECT output field, a WHERE filter or a local ordinary join ON predicate.
structure: A native NULL-test polarity and a checked operand. A VARCHAR read uses its native type and owned occurrence slot.
conditions: The tested text slot belongs to the visible physical scope, including null extension on an outer join. A projection carries the test as a native truth result. Runtime filters admit only true.
meaning: IS NULL observes whether the selected SQL operand is NULL. IS NOT NULL reverses the result. Empty strings, NUL, nonempty whitespace and other exact VARCHAR values are all present. The native integer result is always zero or one.
sql: Preserve the test polarity and render the exact qualified field. Parenthesize the test within Boolean and projection roles.
observations: Native truth type and exact ordered labels
Exact zero or one in the result, including nullable and null-extended fields
Exact per-occurrence filtering and duplicate and null-extended rows in WHERE and ON
